caseNameFull: Florida Public Service Commission v. Federal Communications Commission

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 472 U. S. 1026.] Motion of Telephone Ratepayers Association for Cost-Based and Equitable Rates for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted.

Justice Powell and Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
